- [Object Storage API](https://developers.liara.ir/pages/object-storage.md): Scalable object storage solution for storing and managing data
- [List all Buckets](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/bucket/list-all-buckets.md): List all Bucket

- [Get Single Buckets](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/bucket/get-single-buckets.md)
- [Destroy Bucket](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/bucket/destroy-bucket.md): Delete Bucket on an object storage
- [Check Bucket availability](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/bucket/check-bucket-availability.md): Check if you can create Bucket with specified Name.
- [Migrating buckets](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/bucket/migrating-buckets.md): Move data from one bucket to another
- [List storage service buckets](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/bucket/list-storage-service-buckets.md): List previous buckets of storage service in liara.
- [Get List of Keys](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/key/get-list-of-keys.md)

- [Get Key](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/key/get-key.md): Get a key
- [Delete Key](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/key/delete-key.md): Delete access key
- [Update key](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/key/update-key.md): Update buckets of key ( redefine )
- [Revoke secret key](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/key/revoke-secret-key.md): Revoke secret key
- [Download Object](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/object/download-object.md): Return presigned url for download object
- [Upload Object](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/object/upload-object.md): Return presigned url for download object
- [List Objects](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/object/list-objects.md): Return list of objects ( max:50, min:1 )
- [Delete Object](https://developers.liara.ir/object-storage/object/delete-object.md): Delete an object from storage

- [DNS API](https://developers.liara.ir/pages/dns.md): DNS management API for zones and records
- [List all zones](https://developers.liara.ir/dns/zone/list-all-zones.md): list all zones that user owns
- [Create Zone](https://developers.liara.ir/dns/zone/create-zone.md): creates a new zone on dns server
- [Get Zone](https://developers.liara.ir/dns/zone/get-zone.md): Get this zone, all dns records
- [Delete Zone](https://developers.liara.ir/dns/zone/delete-zone.md): Deletes this zone, all dns records
- [check nameserver](https://developers.liara.ir/dns/check-name-servers/check-nameserver.md): check nameserver of zone
- [Get all dns record](https://developers.liara.ir/dns/dns-record/get-all-dns-record.md): Get all Dns Records on this zone
- [Create dns record](https://developers.liara.ir/dns/dns-record/create-dns-record.md): Creates a new dns record, returns the dns record on creation
- [Get dns record](https://developers.liara.ir/dns/dns-record/get-dns-record.md): Get Dns Record data on this zone
- [edit dns record](https://developers.liara.ir/dns/dns-record/edit-dns-record.md): you can not edit type of dns record
- [delete dns record](https://developers.liara.ir/dns/dns-record/delete-dns-record.md): Delete dns record from this zone

- [Ai](https://developers.liara.ir/pages/ai.md)
- [Create a chat completion](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-chat-completions/chat-completions/create-a-chat-completion.md): Creates a model response for the given conversation. Supports streaming via SSE, tool calling, and multi-modal input (text, images, files).
- [List available models](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-chat-completions/models/list-available-models.md): Lists all AI models available for inference in an OpenAI-compatible format.
- [Generate images](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-image-generation/image-generations/generate-images.md): Generates images from a text prompt. Supports models from OpenAI (gpt-image-1, gpt-image-2) and Google Gemini (Gemini image models).
- [Edit images](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-image-generation/image-edits/edit-images.md): Edits an existing image based on a text prompt. Requires `multipart/form-data` content type.
- [Create embeddings](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-embeddings/embeddings/create-embeddings.md): Generates embeddings for the given input text. Supports single strings or arrays of strings. Response includes token usage and cost information.
- [Generate speech from text](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-tts/text-to-speech/generate-speech-from-text.md): Generates speech audio from the provided text using the specified text-to-speech model.
- [Transcribe audio](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-stt/audio-transcriptions/transcribe-audio.md): Transcribes the provided audio using the specified speech-to-text model.
- [List workspaces](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-workspaces/workspaces/list-workspaces.md): Lists all workspaces owned by the authenticated user.
- [Create a workspace](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-workspaces/workspaces/create-a-workspace.md): Creates a new AI workspace. Only one free (base) workspace is allowed per user. The workspace name must be unique.
- [Check workspace name availability](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-workspaces/workspaces/check-workspace-name-availability.md): Checks if a workspace name is available for use.
- [Get workspace details](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-workspaces/workspaces/get-workspace-details.md): Gets detailed information about a specific workspace.
- [Delete a workspace](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-workspaces/workspaces/delete-a-workspace.md): Soft-deletes a workspace. The workspace will be marked as deleted but not permanently removed.
- [Change provider preferences](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-workspaces/workspace-actions/change-provider-preferences.md): Changes the provider routing preference for a workspace. This affects how requests are routed to AI providers.
- [Resize workspace (change plan)](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-workspaces/workspace-actions/resize-workspace-change-plan.md): Changes the plan of a workspace. The user must have sufficient balance for the new plan's hourly price.
- [Unfreeze workspace](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-workspaces/workspace-actions/unfreeze-workspace.md): Unfreezes a frozen workspace. The user must have sufficient balance to cover the workspace's hourly plan cost.
- [Get free token usage](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-workspaces/workspace-activity/get-free-token-usage.md): Calculates the free token usage for a workspace.
- [Get workspace activity](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-workspaces/workspace-activity/get-workspace-activity.md): Gets aggregated usage activity for a workspace grouped by date and model. Time filter availability depends on the workspace plan: - `base`: hour, day, week - `standard`: hour, day, week, month - `pro`: all filters available
- [Get model limits](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-workspaces/model-limits/get-model-limits.md): Gets the minimum balance and maximum tokens for a specific model within a workspace. Only applies to chat completion models.
- [List API keys](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-keys/api-keys/list-api-keys.md): Lists all API keys owned by the authenticated user, including workspace associations.
- [Create an API key](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-keys/api-keys/create-an-api-key.md): Creates a new API key associated with one or more workspaces. The response includes the key token which is only shown once upon creation.
- [Update an API key](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-keys/api-keys/update-an-api-key.md): Updates an API key's name, workspaces, or enabled status.
- [Delete an API key](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-keys/api-keys/delete-an-api-key.md): Soft-deletes an API key. The key will be marked as deleted but not permanently removed.
- [List all models](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-models/model-catalog-v1/list-all-models.md): Returns all available AI models with full details. No authentication required.
- [Get a model](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-models/model-catalog-v1/get-a-model.md): Gets a single model by its ID. No authentication required.
- [List models with filters](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-models/model-catalog-v2/list-models-with-filters.md): Returns paginated model list with filtering, sorting, and search capabilities. No authentication required. Page size is 20.
- [List logs](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-logs/logs/list-logs.md): Lists paginated request logs for a workspace. Date range is constrained by the workspace plan's log retention period.
- [Get log details (API key auth)](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-logs/logs/get-log-details-api-key-auth.md): Gets detailed information about a specific log entry. Authenticated via API key.
- [Get log details (playground auth)](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-logs/logs/get-log-details-playground-auth.md): Gets detailed information about a specific playground log entry. Authenticated via JWT.
- [Playground chat completion](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-playground/playground-chat/playground-chat-completion.md): Creates a chat completion in the playground. Requires `ai.operate` or `ai.manage` permission. Uses the same request/response format as the API key chat completion endpoint.
- [Playground list models](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-playground/playground-chat/playground-list-models.md): Lists available models in the playground. Requires `ai.operate` or `ai.manage` permission. Returns models in OpenAI-compatible format.
- [Playground image generation](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-playground/playground-images/playground-image-generation.md): Generates images in the playground. Requires `ai.operate` or `ai.manage` permission. Uses the same request/response format as the API key image generation endpoint.
- [Playground image edit](https://developers.liara.ir/ai-playground/playground-images/playground-image-edit.md): Edits images in the playground. Requires `ai.operate` or `ai.manage` permission. Requires `multipart/form-data` content type.
- [Get current user billing information](https://developers.liara.ir/billing/billing/get-current-user-billing-information.md): Returns the current user's balance and billing configuration.
- [Get current user and console information](https://developers.liara.ir/account/user/get-current-user-and-console-information.md): Returns the authenticated user profile and console configuration. In team mode, the response also includes a `team` object.
- [Get current subscription plan](https://developers.liara.ir/account/user/get-current-subscription-plan.md): Returns the current subscription plan of the user (or the team in team mode). Returns an empty object when there is no active plan.
- [Get two-factor authentication status](https://developers.liara.ir/account/user/get-two-factor-authentication-status.md): Returns the two-factor authentication status of the user. Both fields are omitted for teams.
- [Get remaining free credit](https://developers.liara.ir/account/user/get-remaining-free-credit.md): Returns the remaining free credit of the user. The field is omitted for teams.
- [Get Git integrations](https://developers.liara.ir/account/user/get-git-integrations.md): Returns the connected Git providers and their repository integrations.
- [Get UTM information](https://developers.liara.ir/account/user/get-utm-information.md): Returns the UTM campaign the account joined through, or null if none.
